name: Shen Lou
description: The giant building ship in "The Moon in the Qin Dynasty" has exquisite structure and grandeur. It is the master of domineering mechanism skills and yin and yang skills. The mirage is like a city on the sea, dotted with pavilions and pavilions. Spaces such as Toad Palace, Sakura Prison, Yunxiao Pavilion, and Zibei Water Pavilion are cleverly laid out. The corners of the building are full of hidden mechanisms, which are mysterious and dangerous.
